## Flash Sentry — Equestria Girls / G4

**Who he is.** Flash is the blue-haired Canterlot High guitarist and Sunset Shimmer's ex-boyfriend who develops a crush on **Princess Twilight Sparkle**. His Equestrian **counterpart is a separate Pegasus royal guard** in the Crystal Empire—not a secret identity. In *Spring Breakdown*, the human Flash himself briefly takes pony form after entering Equestria; that does not make him the guard. [Human profile](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Flash_Sentry_%28EG%29) · [Pony profile](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Flash_Sentry)

**Spot him.** Human Flash has amber-yellow skin, spiky sapphire hair, blue eyes, a black jacket with red/white bands and a lightning-bolt/shield emblem, and often a red electric guitar. The golden-orange Pegasus has blue mane and tail, blue eyes, and elaborate gold guard armor. His band is **Flash Drive**.

**Name.** **Flash Sentry** is the established franchise/merchandise name. Before the 2013 film, fans nicknamed the blue-haired newcomer **“Brad”**; writer Meghan McCarthy jokingly suggested **“Dreamy Cutebottom”** in a May 16, 2013 post marked “#notreally.” Neither is his official name or a separate persona. [Name and development](https://equestriagirls.fandom.com/wiki/Flash_Sentry)

**Where/voice.** He debuts in *Equestria Girls* (2013); human Flash returns in *Rainbow Rocks*, *Friendship Games*, *Legend of Everfree*, *Forgotten Friendship*, *Spring Breakdown*, and digital shorts, notably *Cheer You On*. The Pegasus speaks in the first movie and *Twilight's Kingdom – Part 1*, but has silent appearances in *Three's A Crowd*, *Forgotten Friendship*, and *The Last Problem*. **Vincent Tong** voices both in English and sings human Flash's *Cheer You On*. Pony Flash also appears in IDW's *Micro-Series* #10 and *Friends Forever* #9 (where one comic panel unusually depicts him with a horn). [Song details](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Cheer_You_On) · [Merchandise documentation](https://www.mylittlewiki.org/wiki/Equestria_Girls_Flash_Sentry)
